jei.creationcore.info.title: Creation Core · Item Guide
jei.creationcore.info.base_matter: Matter transformed by a special Wither, used to obtain Creative Matter.  Expose Blank Matter to a Wither's birth explosion to transform the Wither. Defeat it to obtain Base Matter.
jei.creationcore.info.creative_matter: Base Matter transformed through the power of the Ender Dragon.  Place Base Matter at the center of the End exit fountain and defeat the dragon. When the return portal forms, Base Matter is consumed and Creative Matter appears above the fountain.
jei.creationcore.info.creative_core: Used to craft the Creative Crafting Table, Creative Crafter and Mine Craft.  Put exactly one Creative Matter and nothing else in a shulker box, then drop it into the End exit portal. The box and its contents are consumed. A Creative Core appears near Overworld spawn. Approach to collect it.
jei.creationcore.info.void_bucket: Collects and contains Nothing.  Drop an empty iron bucket into the void. The transformed Void Bucket rises from the void and can be collected on its return.
jei.creationcore.info.bottled_nothing: Nothing sealed in a bottle, used to craft Blank Matter and special blocks.  In an ordinary Crafting Table, craft glass around a Void Bucket. An ordinary empty bucket is returned when the bottles are taken.
jei.creationcore.info.blank_matter: Untransformed matter, used to obtain Base Matter.  Combine Bottled Nothing, tinted glass and sticks in the ordinary Crafting Table to obtain Blank Matter.
jei.creationcore.info.creative_crafting_: Supports Creation Core's exclusive recipes as well as ordinary crafting recipes.  Use a Creative Core as a smithing template to combine a crafting table and a netherite ingot.
jei.creationcore.info.mine_craft: Combines multiple mining tools and can break blocks that normally resist mining. It does not lose durability.  Combine a netherite pickaxe, sword, axe and shovel with a Creative Core in the Creative Crafting Table.
jei.creationcore.disc_copy_remainder: Produces 1 copy and returns the original disc (2 total)
jei.creationcore.info.creative_crafter: Automatically crafts Creative Crafting recipes as well as ordinary crafting recipes.  Use a Creative Core as the smithing template to combine a Crafter with a Netherite Ingot. Supply ingredients and apply a redstone pulse to craft. Hoppers can supply inputs, and outputs enter the container in front.
upgrade.creationcore.wrong_storage: This creative crafting upgrade belongs to a different storage mod
